suggestions.topic: Python AsyncIO vs Threading: When to Stop Blocking
suggestions.rationale: Developers continually confuse I/O-bound concurrency with CPU-bound parallelism, leading to broken server architectures. This short breaks down when to use event loops versus system threads using clear mental models.
suggestions.hook_angle: Stop using threads for I/O-bound tasks until you understand what the Python Global Interpreter Lock is actually doing to your runtime performance.

suggestions.rationale: Cascading failures are the #1 killer of distributed architectures. System design interview candidates and production engineers urgently need practical failure-isolation strategies.
suggestions.hook_angle: One slow database query just took down your entire microservices architecture. Here is how the Circuit Breaker pattern isolates cascading failures before they reach production.
